about: Coaticook is a city in Quebec’s Eastern Townships (Estrie), in the Coaticook River gorge country near the Vermont border. A compact downtown, the Parc de la Gorge, Foresta Lumina night walk, and a dairy-and-maple hinterland define the community. About 9,000 people live in Coaticook.
seoSummary: Eastern Townships city near Vermont—Coaticook Gorge, Foresta Lumina, and dairy country.
knownFor: Eastern Townships city on the Coaticook River
